body:
Hey again everyone. Another week gone! We've had 8 enchant discoveries so far. It's been great to see everyone's theories about what's to come. Time for a quick reminder and to summarize the main updates from the past week!


🔭 Build Contest Reminder

Reminder that there are just over 48 hours left in the Observatory build contest, and that the top 3 entrants get 2 Boundary Fragments. Good luck!

📝General Updates

  • 💎 Valor & Trials:

    • Added a new Silence Tonic (seen below) to the Artifact Trader for a water bottle and Rune of Echoes. Use one on an entity to silence it. Each has two uses.

    • Fixed bugs with the Asteroids Hawking class and adjusted its boss fighting prowess. The bonus warp damage to bosses is lower, but it now generates Entropy when damaging bosses with warps or the black hole.

  • 📖 Lexicon:

    • Added `/lexicon by_rune <rune>` to view all enchants whose recipes use the rune. This replaces the list in each `/rune` entry.

    • Updated `/rune` to show the rune's main *meanings*, the spell it casts in the Runic Tome, and a link to its `/lexicon by_rune`.

  • 🪄 Enchantment adjustments:

    • Buffed the hunger/saturation restored by Taste Test.

    • Added rooted dirt and gravel as low-value transmutables for Transmuting shovels.

  • 🌎 Rune Locales:

    • Increased spawn rates in Skatheim (Chills) and The Allforge (Moments), and increased the strength of The Allforge's copper golems.

    • Added corrupted variants of Arkose (Mortus) and Plimmýra (Tides). Thanks beccc!

  • ✏️Miscellaneous:

    • Made poisonous potatoes compostable in a composter.

    • Fixed `/sit` and similar commands not working in chome...

    • Many other minor balance tweaks, bug fixes, and general optimizations.


Thanks friends! 🫶
